title: Keep the workspace shell mounted during navigation
implementation_note: The root layout now owns ApplicationFrame and StoreProvider. Owner routes share one resource identity, so navigation keeps the authenticated shell and loaded data mounted; initial and lazily loaded content use page-shaped skeletons. Audience or owner identity changes mask/remount private views.
acceptance: Navigate all five primary sections on a delayed connection: header/sidebar remain, current section updates immediately, no repeated global opener, and no owner data appears on buyer/public routes.

title: Separate public, auth, owner and buyer loading
implementation_note: Resource scopes distinguish owner, session-only marketing/auth, public profile, buyer engagement/version and passive routes. Public/auth pages avoid the private workspace bootstrap; buyer reads use buyer state, and payment return performs its own scoped payment-status check.
acceptance: Break owner-state endpoint: signed-out marketing and sign-in still work; buyer/payment requests never request owner state.

title: Reduce returning-user bootstrap work
implementation_note: Returning owner pages read /api/workspace/state directly instead of first requesting Auth and unconditionally ensuring a workspace. Only WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND triggers an idempotent workspace recovery POST; the authenticated Google completion still prepares new workspaces. Hosted before/after latency measurement is not claimed.
acceptance: Record same-profile request count and time to useful page before/after. Returning accounts avoid redundant ensure POST; new accounts still receive exactly one workspace.

title: Deduplicate and scope background refresh
implementation_note: ScopedRead coalesces same-scope reads and aborts abandoned audiences. Polling waits for queued writes, pauses in hidden/offline tabs and backs off failures; projection signatures ignore generated clocks while retaining equal-revision worker changes. Full-state reads remain; server pagination, delta transport and granular selectors are deferred.
acceptance: At most one state read in flight during a 20-second delay; repeated failures back off; hidden tabs pause; unchanged polls do not rerender every consumer; new worker state still arrives.

title: Bound requests and handle uncertain outcomes
implementation_note: BackendClient bounds reads and writes with AbortController timeouts, normalizes connection/HTTP failures and unreadable proxy responses, and retains request IDs. CommandIntents coalesces duplicate submissions and preserves the same retry key after uncertain writes; the adapter never silently resends a mutation.
acceptance: Offline, hung read, HTML 502, rate limit and stale conflict each show a specific recovery. A lost response after commit never produces a second invoice/send/payment.

title: Make every action visibly pending and prevent repeated intent
implementation_note: Shared Button awaits asynchronous handlers with a stable-width pending label and busy semantics. Form prevents repeated submission, freezes mutation fields and sibling actions, and Modal/Confirm guard unresolved closing. Work, money, acquisition and tool flows return promises or maintain explicit in-flight locks.
implementation_paths: src/components/ui.tsx; src/app/globals.css; src/views/work.tsx; src/views/money.tsx; src/views/acquisition.tsx; src/views/integration-tools.tsx
acceptance: Delay each mutation eight seconds, double-click/press Enter repeatedly: one action is dispatched, pending is announced once, dimensions stay stable, failure retains input.

title: Show confirmed saves without waiting for a full workspace reload
implementation_note: ConnectedStore returns the confirmed command receipt before canonical background revalidation completes, keeps the previous projection usable and distinguishes saved-but-stale refresh failures from rejected writes. Confirmed intents remain deduplicated until reconciliation. Authoritative entity patches are not returned by all endpoints.
acceptance: A confirmed task save becomes visible even when the next state read fails. Related views converge without a second submit.

title: Give forms useful field-level correction
implementation_note: Canonical Form converts native constraints into a linked error summary and first-invalid focus; Field supplies field errors and described-by relationships. Work/money/acquisition forms use the shared contract, with additional authored errors in key editors. Some domain rejections remain form-level rather than field-mapped.
acceptance: Empty and one-invalid-field submissions identify the exact field, requirement and correction visually and to assistive technology; correction removes only that error; no lost draft.

title: Repair task and milestone command contracts
implementation_note: TaskEditor and MilestoneEditor now submit task.save/milestone.save through narrow shared domain handlers. Generic task/milestone writes are denied; ownership, project membership, current versions and terminal/accepted history are validated. Changing an agreed milestone date creates a nonbinding change note instead of altering accepted terms.
acceptance: Create/edit professional and admin tasks and milestones, reload, compare owner/buyer visibility and dependencies. Invalid changes remain inline without discarding the draft.

title: Make milestone task assignment atomic or report partial completion
implementation_note: milestone.save validates the milestone and every affected task version before updating any assignment. The shared execute snapshot and connected PostgreSQL transaction commit the milestone, project relationship and task changes together; a missing or stale task rolls back the whole action and keeps the editor draft.
acceptance: Introduce a version conflict on one task mid-save: all changes roll back or the editor clearly names partial completion and retains the retryable selection.

title: Repair project attachment and reference-link saving
implementation_note: Project bytes use file.attach and references use file.link; archive/restore has its own file command. The open form retains uploaded metadata and failed selections, reports file progress and derives visibility explicitly. Server metadata, upload scope/provenance, alias binding and accepted-file guards protect private bytes and immutable delivery history.
implementation_paths: src/views/work.tsx; src/lib/work-commands.ts; src/server/domain.ts; src/lib/engine.ts; src/lib/projections.ts; src/views/public.tsx
acceptance: Single/batch/replacement upload and HTTPS reference persist, reopen and download after reload; buyer sharing is verified; retry does not reupload successful files.

title: Make buyer-access changes explicit
implementation_note: The owner action now explicitly creates/replaces a buyer invitation, with confirmation naming the revocation of previous links and signed-in sessions. The resulting single-use link remains selectable when clipboard writing fails; replacement is recorded without token contents and no email is sent automatically.
acceptance: Copy does not revoke access. Explicit replacement names buyer and consequences, changes access once, and exposes a usable link even if clipboard permission fails.

title: Connect lead assessment UI to the actual Scout run
implementation_note: Lead detail uses activeScoutRun and typed opportunity input_refs, including completed outputs still awaiting owner review, rather than relying on the absent connected opportunity_id field. The current assessment has its own written state and canonical task link, preventing another start while that intent remains active.
acceptance: Starting Scout immediately exposes the same run on the lead and Team; reload and Back preserve the relation; repeated activation creates one intent.

title: Stop read notifications from notifying themselves
implementation_note: The activity policy excludes ui.set/read-state/preferences bookkeeping from new team events and filters equivalent historical events. Notification counts and mark-read actions use business updates, so marking everything read does not manufacture a fresh unread notification.
acceptance: Mark all reaches zero and remains zero after poll/reload. New real activity increments once; reading preferences never creates its own notification.

title: Explain queued, delayed and blocked agent work honestly
implementation_note: Run inspectors distinguish queued, running, owner-input, review, blocked, failed and completed work. Delayed runs show an honest two-minute inactivity explanation, check-status and context-aware manual continuation without inventing progress or ETA. Actual worker hosting/health is unknown and must be established operationally.
acceptance: Absent worker, delayed queue, provider failure, input wait and completion have distinct useful states. Users can leave/return to the same task and cannot accidentally duplicate paid attempts.

title: Make Google sign-in handoff and return legible
implementation_note: Google sign-in now passes through an in-app /auth/verify handoff for provider opening and workspace preparation. Readable live status, slow/error recovery, safe owner return destinations and cancellation/expiry messages explain the transition; signed-in users receive a primary continue-to-workspace action.
implementation_paths: src/app/auth/verify/page.tsx; src/views/auth-handoff.tsx; src/views/connected-auth.tsx; src/lib/auth-experience.ts; src/app/api/auth/[action]/route.ts; src/server/auth-redirect.ts
acceptance: First/return login, cancel, expired callback and unavailable workspace stay understandable and recoverable, with no raw API JSON or OAuth loop. Verify rendered status contrast and screen-reader announcements.

title: Recover from session expiry without discarding safe drafts
implementation_note: A 401 during an existing owner session preserves the mounted page and in-memory draft, blocks writes, and presents new-tab sign-in plus reconnect. Owner identity is bound to commands and remounts private forms when an account changes. Closing or reloading the original tab does not persist these private drafts.
acceptance: Expire session mid-edit: same user can recover safe draft and review stale version; a different account never sees it; one prompt replaces repeated failure toasts.

title: Use one overlay-aware notification system
implementation_note: Both store modes use one dismissible NotificationToast. It portals to the active native dialog or body, announces politely, names its 44px dismiss control and does not rely on automatic disappearance for recovery. Important form errors remain inline after dismissal.
acceptance: Concurrent save/read errors remain visible and distinct, including inside an open dialog. Poll repeats announce once; critical recovery remains after transient toast dismissal.

title: Separate connected recovery from local-demo recovery
implementation_note: Connected recovery exposes refresh/reconnect and retained server-backed data; it no longer offers a local sample export/reset for a backend failure. Browser-demo storage recovery retains its separate local export/reset controls and sample disclosure.
acceptance: Connected outage offers no misleading sample reset/export. Corrupt sample state still has honest recovery. Neither error path loops or loses safe input.

title: Remove sample wording and hardcoded owner identity from connected flows
implementation_note: Connected work/messages/offers/PDFs and voice surfaces use mode-appropriate storage, portal, external-send and recording wording. Work task ownership/signatures derive from the owner record; connected UI avoids the prior hardcoded Alya/sample claims while the separate demo keeps truthful simulation disclosure.
implementation_paths: src/views/work.tsx; src/views/acquisition.tsx; src/views/money.tsx; src/views/connected-voice.tsx; src/views/public.tsx; src/components/shell.tsx; src/lib/downloads.ts
acceptance: Owner/buyer/export walkthrough shows actual identity and truthful storage/send/payment environment; no real action is called simulated or vice versa.

title: Complete English/Bahasa interface localization
implementation_note: Expanded the EN/ID dictionary and introduced UiText for authored interface strings outside shared controls. Shared status, validation, actions and accessible names now use the active translator across major route families. Exhaustive owned-copy coverage and native-language verification are not complete; user-authored business content is preserved.
implementation_paths: src/lib/i18n.ts; src/components/ui-text.tsx; src/components/ui.tsx; src/components/shell.tsx; src/views/work.tsx; src/views/public.tsx; src/views/integration-tools.tsx
acceptance: Walk route families/overlays in EN and ID with long labels and zero/one/many counts. Locale switch retains work and no unexplained English interface copy remains.

title: Expose selected state without relying on color
implementation_note: Project List/Board, Calendar view, notification All/Unread, focus and team selection expose pressed state. Desktop/mobile route links use aria-current, and mobile menu expansion/dialog semantics identify navigation state without depending on color.
acceptance: Keyboard and assistive technology identify selected view, active filter and current section. Focus remains stable when toggling.

title: Keep long-form actions within reach
implementation_note: Long-dialog action rows, including Work form footers, are sticky with surface/border separation and safe-area padding. Dialog scrolling reserves space around controls; pending forms keep close/cancel locked until their result resolves. Representative phone/reflow checks supplement the shared layout contract.
implementation_paths: src/app/globals.css; src/components/ui.tsx; src/views/work.css; src/views/work.tsx; src/views/money.tsx; src/views/acquisition.tsx
acceptance: At 390×844, tablet and 200% zoom every field and Cancel/Save remain reachable with no page-wide horizontal scroll or obscured focus.

title: Give knowledge search a complete result lifecycle
implementation_note: Knowledge search now distinguishes initial guidance, searching, errors and completed zero/matching results, explains indexing prerequisites and links matches to sources. Abort/generation guards prevent an older response or a cleared query from replacing the current result state.
acceptance: Untouched/searching/zero/results/index-pending/error/overlapping searches are distinct; latest query wins; source filters cannot be confused with semantic search.

title: Distinguish empty integration results from incomplete checks
implementation_note: Drive distinguishes no accessible files, imported files and first-page limits. Calendar checks validate the interval and provider error entries before claiming a checked empty snapshot. Exa discovery validates allowed domains, reports no matches and saves unverified evidence only for review; each tool owns its pending/error feedback.
acceptance: Idle, pending, empty, results and failed-after-results states are distinct. Calendar checking does not freeze Drive import; stale results are labeled or cleared.

title: Make payment return status finite and truthful
implementation_note: Payment return maps provider states to distinct copy, stops terminal checks, bounds nonterminal polling with backoff and offers manual status checking/return navigation. Checkout-start actions retain request identity, use visible pending/error states and the shared primary style; only verified provider confirmation produces received copy.
acceptance: Sandbox status matrix gives distinct correct copy/actions; confirmation stops polls; invalid links recover immediately; checkout return never alone proves payment.

title: Bind overlap consent to the exact calendar proposal
implementation_note: Calendar overlap acknowledgement is keyed to the proposed start/end, timezone, project, attendee, kind and conflicting event IDs/versions/times. Editing that context or receiving different loaded conflicts requires renewed acknowledgement. The warning concerns internal scheduling and does not authorize changes to accepted agreement dates.
acceptance: Acknowledge overlap A, change to overlap B: new acknowledgment required. Change to a free interval: no warning.

title: Restore the project’s 44px interaction target baseline
implementation_note: Shared controls and shell utilities restore 44px comfortable targets; topbar icon buttons, mobile controls, dismiss actions, pagination and calendar interactions receive explicit sizing/spacing rules. This is the project interaction baseline, not a claim that every element has completed a WCAG conformance assessment.
source: DESIGN.md Responsive and accessibility; src/components/shell.tsx header; src/app/globals.css button variants
acceptance: DOM geometry checks at all required widths show 44px core target hit areas, no overlap, keyboard names/focus intact.

title: Remove repeated assistant entry points
implementation_note: The shared shell exposes one assistant entry for ordinary routes, while Home/Team retain their contextual composer without a duplicate header trigger. All entries open the same Delegate surface and draft/task flow; repeated page-specific assistant actions were removed.
acceptance: Each viewport has one primary assistant entry surface; all triggers resume the same safe draft and context instead of opening separate composers.

title: Make the next decision easier to reach on Home
implementation_note: Home places its selected owner decision before secondary activity and reduces the greeting/art footprint, especially on compact screens. The briefing keeps concise record-derived facts and one canonical action instead of delaying the next decision behind expanded status sections.
acceptance: Returning user can identify the primary decision without scanning unrelated metrics or scrolling past a large welcome panel; approved Home anchors and six-character identity remain recognizable.

title: Keep the sidebar account block compact
implementation_note: The sidebar account chip now shows a compact display name and profession rather than the long business headline. Name truncation, bounded copy and a stable minimum chip height keep the lower navigation from turning into a tall account block.
acceptance: Short/long business names at desktop/tablet do not crowd navigation or place controls offscreen. Profile opens full details without hover dependence.

title: Simplify the zero-record Money experience
implementation_note: Invoice/payment/expense screens hide irrelevant summaries, filters and pagination when there are no applicable records, and use written unknown/empty labels rather than ambiguous dashes. Each empty ledger presents one useful create action and currency-grouped summaries return when records exist.
acceptance: No records, no matches, load failure and known zero have distinct copy/actions; no empty pagination; currency totals remain truthful.

title: Explain unavailable integration tools before activation
implementation_note: Drive and Calendar tools explain the specific missing capability and link to its consent controls before activation. Unsupported actions stay disabled with a readable prerequisite; connected scope choices, tool-specific status and recovery distinguish account sign-in from optional integration permission.
acceptance: Disconnected, partially scoped, expired and connected states all identify what works and how to recover; no unrelated permission request is implied.

title: Verify contrast on the actual state users encounter
implementation_note: The new app-owned sign-in handoff and pending/error/status surfaces use the readable ink/forest/semantic design tokens with written state and live announcements; busy buttons keep full opacity. The exact earlier verification state is unavailable for comparison, and whole-app contrast/assistive conformance is not certified.
acceptance: Rendered normal text ≥4.5:1, qualifying large text ≥3:1; required nontext indicators meet applicable contrast; status is perceivable independent of color and animation.

title: Give long input comfortable size and expansion
implementation_note: Inputs/selects/textareas use a shared 16px text baseline. Field-managed textareas grow with content up to the 360px cap and then scroll, retaining minimum reading space. Real iOS focus/virtual-keyboard behavior remains outstanding.
acceptance: Long briefs, invoice rows and EN/ID labels remain readable at narrow width and zoom; supported iOS form focus is verified; expand/collapse retains content and focus.

title: Make page and section context more specific
implementation_note: Canonical PageHead headings, subsection navigation, current-route markers and document-title/focus handling preserve route context through the persistent shell. Related screens remain grouped under their primary topbar section; record detail and local tabs supply the more specific business context.
source: src/views/public.tsx settings; src/components/application.tsx route resolution; src/components/shell.tsx
acceptance: Direct load/refresh/Back/Forward and invalid IDs preserve the right context; heading/title identify Knowledge, Calendar, offer or invoice; no wrong-record fallback.

title: Verify responsive behavior as a complete workflow
implementation_note: Responsive source rules and maintained production-UI fixtures cover representative Home/Team/Money reflow, navigation and Work dialogs at desktop/tablet/phone widths, plus a 200%-equivalent CSS viewport. Real devices, screen readers and true browser-zoom/virtual-keyboard matrices remain outside the current environment.
implementation_paths: src/app/globals.css; src/components/shell.css; src/views/home-team.css; src/views/work.css; tests/e2e/ux-shell.spec.ts; tests/e2e/ux-work.spec.ts; playwright.ux.config.ts
source: DESIGN.md Responsive and accessibility; UX-CONTRACT.md; domain CSS
acceptance: 1440×1000, 1280×900, 1024px and 390×844 plus 200% zoom pass representative list/detail/form/buyer flows without page-wide horizontal scroll. Record real evidence.

title: Keep character personality with focused working screens
implementation_note: Preserved the six original crew assets, forest/ivory palette, Newsreader/Inter typography and Team map identity. Working screens use calmer spacing and action hierarchy, while Home/Team carry the stronger character presence; design context explicitly keeps personality subordinate to commercial/error decisions.
source: DESIGN.md identity/Home/Team/motion; skills/CREWMORI_SKILL_ADAPTER.md; user-supplied discussion image
acceptance: Roles remain recognizable at small sizes, state is written in text, reduced motion retains all meaning, illustration does not push required actions below the useful viewport or distract from critical terms.

title: Reconcile active context for connected mode
implementation_note: The active master context and handoff now describe the connected 1.2.0 application, Google-only auth, private storage, separate worker and remaining verification limits. Older frontend-only master documents are retained as historical context rather than allowed to imply that connected actions are browser samples.
implementation_paths: docs/MASTER_CONTEXT.md; docs/MASTER_AI_CONTEXT.md; docs/IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md; docs/BACKEND.md; docs/WORKER_OPERATIONS.md; README.md; UX-CONTRACT.md; DESIGN.md
acceptance: A new implementer can identify current auth, storage, worker, financial confirmation, canonical control owners and visual overlay from one index; no contradictory active instruction remains.

title: Profile initial code and split expensive route features deliberately
implementation_note: Application now dynamically loads acquisition, work, money, settings and public route views with contextual skeleton fallbacks while keeping the shared shell mounted. This reduces eager route coupling; production bundle/CWV profiling and a hosted timing comparison are still deferred.
acceptance: Before/after report identifies JS bytes, parse/hydrate and time-to-useful-page under same profile. Heavy exports are loaded on demand without new route flashes or accessibility regressions.

title: Standardize search and list restoration
implementation_note: Shared SearchBar uses a labelled, immediate clear action. Acquisition, Work and Money lists retain query/filter/sort/page/view state in URL-backed controls and reset pagination when search/filter changes; distinct empty/filter states and canonical return links preserve list context.
source: src/components/ui.tsx shared search/list; src/views/knowledge-search.tsx; src/views/integration-tools.tsx; domain lists
acceptance: Type rapidly, clear, press Enter, navigate Back and change filters on last page: latest result wins, correct list state returns, and paging is never stranded. Sensitive queries are not put into URLs by default.

title: Reveal global-search result limits
implementation_note: Workspace search ranks authorized saved records and exposes the full match count, initially displaying 30 with an explicit Show more results control. Clearing query/type resets the shown count immediately; archived/unavailable domain navigation still follows each canonical destination.
acceptance: Test 0/1/30/31/200 matches, including an invoice behind 30 opportunity matches: truncation is visible and every relevant record remains discoverable by refining or paging.

title: Make mobile navigation an accessible drawer
implementation_note: Mobile navigation opens a named native modal drawer with expanded/control semantics, all primary/tool destinations and body scroll locking. The shared dialog contains focus, supports Escape and restores the menu trigger; current mobile destinations expose aria-current.
acceptance: At 390px and 1024px keyboard/screen reader can open, reach all destinations and close to trigger without traversing visually obscured content; modal background does not scroll.

title: Explain an empty notification center
implementation_note: The notification center now distinguishes no team updates from an unread filter that is caught up, keeps All/Unread selection explicit and disables mark-all when the unread count is zero. Business-event filtering prevents view-preference bookkeeping from confusing this empty state.
acceptance: Initial empty All, caught-up Unread, loading and failure are distinguishable; mark-all at zero emits no command.

title: Initialize connection access from actual granted scopes
implementation_note: Connection checkboxes initialize from current granted scopes/capabilities, with a separate unsent consent draft. The page explains added/removed access, refreshes actual granted permissions after return and exposes read/write Calendar differences; unavailable tool buttons derive from that same capability model.
acceptance: Reopening Update access mirrors saved permissions; no-change update does not silently request more; removing a capability explains what will stop while preserving records.

title: Choose Home priority from all existing owner decisions
implementation_note: The Home selector prioritizes saved rescheduling/blocked projects, overdue issued invoices, owner-input/review work and prerequisite needs before remaining offer actions. Every card links to its existing canonical record, and selection does not infer payment, acceptance or delivery from AI progress.
acceptance: Empty account, project waiting for inputs, overdue invoice, review-ready offer and caught-up account each receive truthful useful next action; a stale offer does not mask urgent work.
